results.name: any left-half start anchors to Chang without teleporting or requiring a fixed center
eight directions track both axes with a bounded vector and correct facing
a stationary finger lets Chang reach its target and stop; tiny drags remain responsive
unrestricted long drag can reverse and cross the center without returning to an origin
finger displacement uses the rendered canvas scale and does not depend on touch location
release, cancellation and lost capture brake horizontal drift within eight ticks and restore gravity
unrelated fingers cannot steal movement or release its owner
blur, viewport changes and pause discard ownership and require a new touch
jump, hurt, stomp and keyboard retain priority independently of touch release
ceiling, floor, world boundaries and solid tiles constrain direct movement
Touch Events fallback owns one identifier and clears cancellation without blocking unrelated contacts

limitations: Actual input handlers and physics in a VM with DOM/canvas fixtures.
Physical mobile hardware is unavailable; browser touch/capture checks are recorded separately.
